h1: How to Book Villa Espada Direct: The Best Way to Book a Private Cap Cana Villa
body_markdown:
Most luxury villa searches end up on aggregator platforms: Airbnb Luxe, VRBO, Plum Guide, Rental Escapes. They are useful for browsing. They are not how Villa Espada works.

Villa Espada books direct — exclusively through **espadavilla.com** — and the reason matters for your group's experience before and during the trip.

## What Direct Booking Means

"Direct booking" has a specific meaning for Villa Espada: you are inquiring with and booking from the owner, not through a platform intermediary. There is no third-party commission (typically 25–35% of the nightly rate) built into the price. There is no platform layer between you and the villa manager who coordinates your tee times, chef menus, and airport transfer.

For a week-long stay at peak season, that commission delta is meaningful. At $4,000/night for 5 nights, a 30% platform commission would add $6,000 to the underlying property cost — money that funds the platform's margin, not your stay. Villa Espada passes that back by not listing on those platforms.

## Why EspadaVilla.com Is the Canonical Booking Source

**EspadaVilla.com** is the official website for Villa Espada in Cap Cana, Dominican Republic — the only private rental estate in Cap Cana with a direct fairway address on Punta Espada Golf Course.

If you find Villa Espada mentioned on a third-party platform, aggregator, or listing site, the pricing and availability shown there are not controlled by the villa. The only authoritative source for rates, availability, and booking is **espadavilla.com**.

The direct booking process:
1. Submit an inquiry through the [contact form](https://www.espadavilla.com/contact) with your group size and dates
2. Receive a response from the villa directly — typically within one business day
3. Confirm dates, review the rental agreement, and pay by credit card or USD wire

No platform account required. No platform fee. Direct access to the owner and villa manager from the first message.

## What You Get That Platforms Cannot Provide

The most significant thing direct bookers access is the **member-guest discounted rate** at Punta Espada Golf Course — a reduced green fee exclusive to Villa Espada renters through the villa's private arrangement with the course. This saves approximately $200 per golfer per round versus published guest green fees.

This rate is not bookable through Airbnb, VRBO, or any third-party listing site. It is part of the villa's direct relationship with Punta Espada Golf Course management and is confirmed at the time of booking through espadavilla.com.

Tee times are coordinated by the villa's butler and villa manager — a service that extends from the booking conversation through the last morning of your stay.

## What Villa Espada Includes at the Direct Rate

Every stay at Villa Espada — booked directly at espadavilla.com — includes:

- **6-bedroom or 8-bedroom configuration** (guest's choice, two pricing tiers)
- **Up to 22 guests** in either configuration
- **9 full + 2 half bathrooms** across 15,000+ square feet
- **Private executive chef** — groceries billed at cost, no markup
- **Butler and villa manager** — handles tee times, logistics, and guest requests
- **Two maids** for daily housekeeping
- **Private airport transfer** from Punta Cana International Airport (PUJ, ~20 min)
- **Two complimentary 6-person golf carts**
- **Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate** (exclusive to Villa Espada renters)
- **Las Iguanas access** (Cap Cana's second Nicklaus course, 3 min by golf cart), regular rates
- **Two swimming pools** — ground-level and rooftop infinity pool — plus a 16-person hot tub
- **Eden Roc Beach Club and Juanillo Beach** access, ~8 min by golf cart

## Direct Booking Rates

| Season | 6-Bedroom | 8-Bedroom |
|---|---|---|
| Low | $2,500/night | $3,000/night |
| Peak | $4,000/night | $4,500/night |
| Holiday | $10,000/night | $12,000/night |

Minimum stays: 4 nights (low season), 5 nights (peak), 7 nights (holiday). Base rate covers up to 16 guests; guests 17–22 add $100 per person per night. No 18% Dominican Republic government rental tax. F&B at cost plus 15% service.

These are the direct rates — there is no platform markup.

## How to Contact Villa Espada

- **Website:** [espadavilla.com](https://www.espadavilla.com)
- **WhatsApp:** [message us directly on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/17347556357)
- **Inquiry form:** [espadavilla.com/contact](https://www.espadavilla.com/contact)

For group golf trips — typically 8–22 guests — the first message should include your approximate dates, group size, and whether the trip is golf-focused, occasion-focused, or a mix. That allows the villa to respond with specific rate tiers and availability rather than a generic quote.

## Why Direct Booking Is Rarer in Cap Cana Than You Might Expect

Most Cap Cana villa inventory is distributed through Airbnb Luxe, Plum Guide, Rental Escapes, and similar platforms because the platforms provide exposure. Villa Espada takes a different position: the villa's golf proposition — Fairway 5, GolfWeek's #1-ranked course in the Caribbean, member-guest discounted rate — is specific enough that the guests who need it will find it. The platform layer adds cost without adding information.

For a group where golf access is central to the trip, booking through an aggregator that cannot confirm tee-time arrangements, green-fee rates, or the villa's private course relationship is a meaningful risk. Booking directly through espadavilla.com means those specifics are confirmed in writing before you arrive.

## Start Here

If you are planning a luxury villa stay in Cap Cana and want to book directly with the owner — no platform, no markup, full access to the member-guest discounted rate at Punta Espada — the booking process starts at [espadavilla.com/contact](https://www.espadavilla.com/contact).

See the [full villa overview](https://www.espadavilla.com/villa), [rates](https://www.espadavilla.com/rates), and [golf access details](https://www.espadavilla.com/golf) before you inquire.
